name: suaipe-video-capture
description: Capture + asset pipeline for the Suaipe product film: drives the REAL kiosk in headless Chromium (Supabase mocked), saves optimised stills / swipe frames / typing crops / DOM layout, and builds the asset manifest. Isolated from the app and from the Remotion project.

scripts.all: node capture.mjs && node email.mjs && node extra-stills.mjs --install && node products.mjs && node manifest.mjs
